EXPERIENCE & AVAILABILITY

See where we are going.
Know what is here.

The website presents the experience in the approved plan. Here is the distinction between the web example, invited builds and what comes next.

Desktop Chrome extension · ChatGPT Web · Invite-only beta
TRY NOW
Open the example.
Try it for yourself.

Try search, edits, prompts, topic reading and four-card scope using fictional inputs. No installation, AI connection or personal data.

Open the interactive example
→
INVITE-ONLY BETA
Start with Chrome
and ChatGPT.

Invitations follow the current testing scope. Invited participants receive a specific build, setup instructions and limitations. Applying is not instant installation.

Request a beta invitation

THE PRODUCT IN PROGRESS

The foundation is here.
The full experience is growing.

“Implemented” means an integrated foundation in the development version. It does not imply a public store release or availability in your installed build. There is no verified public installer or store download.

01
Input Archive
LOCAL FOUNDATION

Local Chrome / ChatGPT capture, search, working-text editing and source readback are integrated.

02
Personal prompts
LOCAL FOUNDATION

Reusable phrases, editing, pinning, ordering and manual insertion are implemented. Optional local next-step suggestions, off by default, are integrated into development builds. Actual support depends on your invited build and site validation.

03
Thought Library
EXPERIENCE IN PROGRESS

Personal topics and section reading have a foundation. Full writing, organization and AI reading are still being completed.

04
Four-card Context
LOCAL FOUNDATION

Local cards and manual management have a foundation. Full automatic maintenance and live external AI reading are not available.

05
AI organization & assistance
PLANNED

Three reading styles and user controls are approved. Live model services, quality validation and billing support are not launched.

06
Personal cloud sync
PLANNED

The approach is approved, with part of the local foundation implemented. Live cloud transport and new-device recovery are not available.

SOURCES & INSTALLATION
Move forward from
a clearly supported scope.

Current capture targets supported ChatGPT pages and sent user text. Other sources, including Claude and Gemini, remain planned. Installation does not automatically collect a complete account history, all AI replies, arbitrary webpages or drafts.

Live sources, devices, signed distribution, updates and import recovery need validation within their own scope. The instructions with your invitation determine what you can try.

Read about data and permissions
